     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
     3	#
     4	# The course's Assignment 6 wrapper, changed in four places for this folder:
     5	#   - The project is game/ (the 2D game, from Assignment 2), so it runs
     6	#     --path game; the course's version runs --path godot. Assignment 6 builds
     7	#     in the 2D game only, so this folder holds no other project.
     8	#   - A .tscn test runs as the scene, as the game's checks.tscn always has (its
     9	#     script extends Node, so --script cannot run it); a .gd test still runs
    10	#     with --script. The log is named after the file without its extension.
    11	#   - Godot is $GODOT if set, else godot on PATH, else the macOS app's binary.
    12	#   - It runs from this folder wherever it is called from, so the project path
    13	#     resolves and the logs land in its logs/.
    14	# Unchanged from the course: the realtime mode (no --fixed-fps, for tests that
    15	# wait on audio), the optional timeout (120 s by default; status 124 means the
    16	# test hung), the log name logs/<test>_<fps>fps.log or logs/<test>_realtime.log,
    17	# and failing on any SHADER ERROR or SCRIPT ERROR line, because exit code 0
    18	# does not mean no errors.
    19	set -o pipefail
    20	cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
    21	if [ $# -lt 2 ] || [ $# -gt 3 ] || [ ! -f "game/tests/$1" ]; then
    22		echo "usage: scripts/run-test.sh <test-file in game/tests/> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]" >&2
    23		exit 2
    24	fi
    25	godot=${GODOT:-$(command -v godot || echo /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot)}
    26	if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
    27		fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
    28	else
    29		fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
    30	fi
    31	if [[ $1 == *.tscn ]]; then
    32		run_args=("res://tests/$1")
    33	else
    34		run_args=(--script "res://tests/$1")
    35	fi
    36	mkdir -p logs
    37	log="logs/$(basename "${1%.*}")_${tag}.log"
    38	timeout "${3:-120}" "$godot" --headless "${fps_args[@]}" --path game "${run_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
    39	status=$?
    40	if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR" "$log"; then status=1; fi
    41	exit $status

     4	## named by the pose's asset ID in CHARACTER-SHEET.md; his Look shows that ID's

     9	## jump straight up keeps the rising pose all the way down; the pose changes
    10	## at most once in the air, at the top.

    12	## On the ground, pressing the other direction turns him in place at once, with
    13	## no slide; he moves that way only if the key is still held after

     8	##   same screen. The title shows once each time the game starts: Enter on the
     9	##   end card plays again without it;

    12	##   last heart. After a fade every monster is back where it started, even the
    13	##   defeated ones, and so is the sword-and-shield pickup. After a fall that leaves him hearts, Rudy gets back up at
    14	##   the last checkpoint, the lit waystone or else the start, with the hearts he
    15	##   has left. Once his last heart is gone, by a hit or a fall, the level starts
    16	##   over from the opening: he is at the start with full hearts, and the
    17	##   waystone is dark;

    19	##   celebrates, the light rises, the camera pulls back, and the screen fades to
    20	##   the end card, where Enter plays the level again from the opening.

    22	## on screen and a fall drops him out of the frame. It shakes briefly on a hit.

    25	## its place, and shows "Paused"; Esc again resumes. Only in play: not on the
    26	## title, through a death and the respawn, or from the teleport circle on.

    30	## Enter starts play; it dips under a hit and through a death and the respawn,

   237	## Moves the swing on and, while its hitbox is live, defeats every goblin in it.
   238	## It asks the physics space directly, so the cut lands on the tick it reaches.
   239	func _swing(delta: float) -> void:
   240		_sword_box.position.x = slash_reach * facing
   241		var live := is_slashing() and _slash_clock >= slash_live_from and _slash_clock <= slash_live_to
   242		_sword_box.disabled = not live
   243		if live:
   244			_slash_query.transform = _sword_box.global_transform
   245			for contact in get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_shape(_slash_query, 8):
   246				if contact.collider is Goblin:

   255	func _drop_gear(away: float) -> void:

   259		flying.velocity = Vector2(away * 220.0, -420.0)

   263	func _count_down(delta: float) -> void:
   264		_invulnerable_left = maxf(_invulnerable_left - delta, 0.0)
   265		if mode == Mode.HURT:
   266			_hurt_time_left -= delta
   267			if _hurt_time_left <= 0.0:

   280		if axis < 0.0:
   281			return -1
   282		return 0

   286		match mode:
   287			Mode.CELEBRATING:
   288				return &"CHAR-CELEBRATE"
   289			Mode.RESPAWNING:
   290				return &"CHAR-RESPAWN"
   291			Mode.DEFEATED:
   292				return &"CHAR-DEFEAT"
   293			Mode.HURT:

   295		if is_slashing():

   298		if not is_on_floor():

   302				_falls_sideways = absf(velocity.x) > 1.0
   303			_was_falling = falling

     1	class_name Main
     2	extends Node2D
     3	## Runs Level 1. It places Rudy, keeps the camera on him, and runs the level's
     4	## states (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, STORYBOARD.md panels 1 and 4–7):
     5	## - TITLE: the game opens on the start of the level with the title on top
     6	##   (UI-TITLE) and Rudy idle, out of the player's control; the hearts are
     7	##   hidden. Enter fades the title out and the hearts in, and play starts on the
     8	##   same screen. The title shows once each time the game starts: Enter on the
     9	##   end card plays again without it;
    10	## - PLAYING;
    11	## - DYING: a fall below a cliff, which costs a heart, or a hit that takes his
    12	##   last heart. After a fade every monster is back where it started, even the
    13	##   defeated ones, and so is the sword-and-shield pickup. After a fall that leaves him hearts, Rudy gets back up at
    14	##   the last checkpoint, the lit waystone or else the start, with the hearts he
    15	##   has left. Once his last heart is gone, by a hit or a fall, the level starts
    16	##   over from the opening: he is at the start with full hearts, and the
    17	##   waystone is dark;
    18	## - COMPLETE: entered once, on the teleport circle. Input stops, Rudy
    19	##   celebrates, the light rises, the camera pulls back, and the screen fades to
    20	##   the end card, where Enter plays the level again from the opening.
    21	## The camera follows Rudy sideways only, so the ground stays at the same height
    22	## on screen and a fall drops him out of the frame. It shakes briefly on a hit.
    23	##
    24	## In play, Esc pauses everything but the music, which drops 12 dB and keeps
    25	## its place, and shows "Paused"; Esc again resumes. Only in play: not on the
    26	## title, through a death and the respawn, or from the teleport circle on.
    27	## SystemKeys reads the key, since this node stops while the game is paused.
    28	##
    29	## The music (Music, CHANGE-BRIEF.md): it starts on the title and plays on when
    30	## Enter starts play; it dips under a hit and through a death and the respawn,
    31	## and never restarts from the top; on the teleport circle it fades out, and
    32	## the end card is silent. A fall plays the hurt sound as he crosses the kill
    33	## line, since it costs a heart.
    34	
    35	signal restart_requested ## only when Main is not the current scene, as in the checks
    36	
    37	enum State { TITLE, PLAYING, DYING, COMPLETE }
    38	
    39	const KILL_Y := 1300.0 ## below this line he has fallen out of the level
    40	const FALL_HOLD := 0.25 ## s after he crosses the kill line, before the fade
    41	const DEFEAT_HOLD := 0.8 ## s in CHAR-DEFEAT before the fade
    42	const FADE_TIME := 0.35 ## s each way
    43	const CELEBRATE_TIME := 2.0 ## s on the circle before the fade to the end card
    44	const END_ZOOM := Vector2(0.8, 0.8)
    45	const ZOOM_TIME := 1.5
    46	const SHAKE_TIME := 0.2 ## s the camera shakes on a hit
    47	const SHAKE_PX := 8.0
    48	
    49	static var title_shown := false ## once the title has shown, a restart goes straight to play
    50	
    51	var state := State.PLAYING
    52	var checkpoint_name := "start"
    53	
    54	var _checkpoint: Vector2
    55	var _end_card_shown := false
    56	var _shake_left := 0.0
    57	
    58	@onready var _level: Node2D = $Level1
    59	@onready var _rudy: Rudy = $Rudy
    60	@onready var _camera: Camera2D = $Camera
    61	@onready var _hud: Hud = $Hud
    62	@onready var _waystone: Waystone = $Level1/Waystone
    63	@onready var _portal: Portal = $Level1/Portal
    64	@onready var _pickup: SwordPickup = $Level1/SwordPickup
    65	
    66	
    67	func _ready() -> void:
    68		_checkpoint = (_level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position
    69		_rudy.global_position = _checkpoint
    70		# The right-hand bound marks the end of the level.
    71		var right_bound: Node2D = _level.get_node("Bounds/Right")
    72		_camera.limit_right = roundi(right_bound.global_position.x)
    73		_snap_camera()
    74		_waystone.activated.connect(_on_waystone_activated)
    75		_portal.reached.connect(_on_portal_reached)
    76		_rudy.hit.connect(_on_rudy_hit)
    77		_rudy.defeated.connect(_on_rudy_defeated)
    78		_hud.track(_rudy)
    79		Music.start()
    80		if not title_shown:
    81			state = State.TITLE
    82			_rudy.mode = Rudy.Mode.WAITING
    83			_hud.show_title()
    84		_show_status()
    85	
    86	
    87	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
    88		_camera.position.x = _rudy.global_position.x
    89		if state == State.PLAYING and _rudy.global_position.y > KILL_Y:
    90			_die(&"fall")
    91	
    92	
    93	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    94		if _shake_left > 0.0:
    95			_shake_left -= delta
    96			var shaking := _shake_left > 0.0
    97			_camera.offset = Vector2(randf_range(-SHAKE_PX, SHAKE_PX), randf_range(-SHAKE_PX, SHAKE_PX)) if shaking else Vector2.ZERO
    98		if state == State.TITLE and Input.is_action_just_pressed(&"restart"):
    99			_start_play()
   100		if _end_card_shown and Input.is_action_just_pressed(&"restart"):
   101			_end_card_shown = false
   102			_restart()
   103	
   104	
   105	## Enter on the title: it fades out, the hearts fade in, and he is the player's.
   106	func _start_play() -> void:
   107		title_shown = true
   108		state = State.PLAYING
   109		_rudy.mode = Rudy.Mode.PLAY
   110		_hud.hide_title(FADE_TIME)
   111		_show_status()
   112	
   113	
   114	## A fall below a cliff, or a defeat at zero hearts. Once his last heart is
   115	## gone, the level starts over from the opening.
   116	func _die(cause: StringName) -> void:
   117		state = State.DYING # set first, so the kill line ignores him from now on
   118		var start_over := true # a defeat: his last heart is gone
   119		if cause == &"fall":
   120			start_over = _rudy.fall_out() # only if the fall took his last heart
   121			Sfx.play(&"hurt")
   122		Music.dip(&"death", Music.DEATH_DIP)
   123		_show_status()
   124		await get_tree().create_timer(FALL_HOLD if cause == &"fall" else DEFEAT_HOLD).timeout
   125		await _hud.fade_to(1.0, FADE_TIME)
   126		if start_over:
   127			_back_to_the_opening()
   128		_rudy.respawn_at(_checkpoint, start_over)
   129		for monster in _level.get_node("Enemies").get_children():
   130			monster.reset()
   131		_pickup.reset() # he gets back up without gear, so the pickup is back where it was
   132		_shake_left = 0.0
   133		_camera.offset = Vector2.ZERO
   134		_snap_camera()
   135		await _hud.fade_to(0.0, FADE_TIME)
   136		if _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.RESPAWNING:
   137			await _rudy.respawned
   138		state = State.PLAYING
   139		Music.end_dip(&"death")
   140		_show_status()
   141	
   142	
   143	## As if the level had just begun: the start is the checkpoint again, and the
   144	## waystone is dark.
   145	func _back_to_the_opening() -> void:
   146		_checkpoint = (_level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position
   147		checkpoint_name = "start"
   148		_waystone.reset()
   149	
   150	
   151	## Esc: pauses play, or resumes it. Only in play.
   152	func toggle_pause() -> void:
   153		var tree := get_tree()
   154		if tree.paused:
   155			tree.paused = false
   156			Music.end_dip(&"pause")
   157			_hud.show_paused(false)
   158		elif state == State.PLAYING:
   159			tree.paused = true
   160			Music.dip(&"pause", Music.PAUSE_DIP)
   161			_hud.show_paused(true)
   162	
   163	
   164	func is_paused() -> bool:
   165		return get_tree().paused
   166	
   167	
   168	func _on_rudy_hit() -> void:
   169		_shake_left = SHAKE_TIME
   170		Music.dip(&"hurt", Music.HURT_DIP, Music.HURT_TIME)
   171	
   172	
   173	func _on_rudy_defeated() -> void:
   174		if state == State.PLAYING:
   175			_die(&"defeat")
   176	
   177	
   178	func _on_waystone_activated(waystone: Waystone) -> void:
   179		_checkpoint = waystone.spawn_point.global_position
   180		checkpoint_name = "waystone"
   181		_show_status()
   182	
   183	
   184	func _on_portal_reached() -> void:
   185		if state != State.PLAYING:
   186			return
   187		state = State.COMPLETE # entered once; input stops
   188		_rudy.celebrate()
   189		Sfx.play(&"portal")
   190		Music.fade_out()
   191		_show_status()
   192		_portal.light_up(CELEBRATE_TIME)
   193		create_tween().tween_property(_camera, "zoom", END_ZOOM, ZOOM_TIME).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE)
   194		await get_tree().create_timer(CELEBRATE_TIME).timeout
   195		await _hud.fade_to(1.0, FADE_TIME)
   196		_hud.show_end_card(FADE_TIME) # Enter works from its first frame
   197		_end_card_shown = true
   198	
   199	
   200	## A level that goes away never leaves the game paused.
   201	func _exit_tree() -> void:
   202		if get_tree().paused:
   203			get_tree().paused = false
   204			Music.end_dip(&"pause")
   205	
   206	
   207	func _restart() -> void:
   208		if get_tree().current_scene == self:
   209			get_tree().reload_current_scene()
   210		else:
   211			restart_requested.emit()
   212	
   213	
   214	func _snap_camera() -> void:
   215		_camera.position.x = _rudy.global_position.x
   216		_camera.reset_smoothing()
   217	
   218	
   219	func _show_status() -> void:
   220		_hud.set_status("%s, checkpoint: %s" % [State.keys()[state], checkpoint_name])

     1	class_name Goblin
     2	extends Area2D
     3	## A patrolling goblin (ENEMY-GOBLIN). It walks back and forth between where it
     4	## starts and `patrol_distance` px to its right. Landing on it from above
     5	## defeats it, with one stomp sound, and bounces Rudy up; touching it any other
     6	## way costs him a heart. After Rudy dies the level calls reset(), and the
     7	## goblin is back where it started, even if it was defeated.
     8	## It asks the physics space each tick whether its box touches Rudy, instead of
     9	## reading the area's overlap list, which reports a contact two ticks late: by
    10	## then a fast fall has sunk his soles too deep to tell a stomp from a side hit.
    11	## Its art (ENEMY-GOBLIN) is two walk frames and a squashed frame, generated
    12	## facing right and mirrored when it walks left, drawn at half scale from
    13	## props.json's origin (its feet) with the outer outline. The box that hurts
    14	## and that Rudy stomps is 40 x 118 px: its body up to the top of its head, not
    15	## its ears, its nose, its swinging arms or the wisps of its hair.
    16	## The origin is at its feet.
    17

    19	const WALK_B := preload("res://content/goblin/frames/ENEMY-GOBLIN-WALK-B.png")
    20	const SQUASH := preload("res://content/goblin/frames/ENEMY-GOBLIN-SQUASH.png")
    21	const HEIGHT := 118.0 ## the box's height: the top of its head
    22	const WIDTH := 40.0 ## the box's width: its body
    23	const STOMP_MARGIN := 14.0 ## px: Rudy's soles must have been at most this far below its top before his last move
    24	const WALK_FRAME_TIME := 0.18
    25	const SQUASH_TIME := 0.4 ## s the squashed frame shows before it disappears
    26	
    27	@export var patrol_distance := 400.0 ## px to the right of where it starts
    28	@export var speed := 100.0 ## px/s
    29

    31	var facing := 1
    32	
    33	var _start_x := 0.0
    34	var _walk_clock := 0.0
    35	var _squash_left := 0.0
    36	var _query := PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()

# CLAUDE.md — Assignment 6 (Walker Rudy, 2D)

This folder stands in for the game repository's root. The Godot project is `game/`; run every command from this folder.

## Project context

- **Godot version:** 4.7.2 stable (`v4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf`, `logs/checks_60fps.log:1`, `logs/import.log:1`). The project declares features `"4.7"` (`game/project.godot:16`).
- **Renderer:** GL Compatibility on desktop and mobile (`game/project.godot:16`, `game/project.godot:95-96`); on this Mac it runs as OpenGL 4.1 on Metal (`evidence/compat-probe/compatibility.log:6`). It does not draw particle trails (`evidence/compat-probe/compatibility.log:4`, `evidence/compat-probe/README.md:34`).
- **Viewport:** 1920 × 1080, `canvas_items` stretch, 1280 × 720 window (`game/project.godot:25-29`).
- **No particles exist yet:** no file in `game/` names a particle class (grep for `Particles`, this session). `game/effects/` and `game/previews/` do not exist yet.

### Effect A — sword-swing sparks (`SlashSparks`)

- **Node type:** a `Node2D` root with two `GPUParticles2D` children, `Flash` and `Sparks`, each with a `ParticleProcessMaterial` (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:64-66`). Scene to create: `game/effects/slash_sparks.tscn` (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:66`).
- **Event owner:** `game/content/rudy/rudy.gd`, `_swing()`, which sets `_sword_box.disabled = not live` every physics tick (`rudy.gd:239-242`); `_sword_box` is `$SwordHitbox/Shape` (`rudy.gd:96`, `game/content/rudy/rudy.tscn:34-43`). A swing starts at `rudy.gd:223-226` and is cancelled by a hit (`rudy.gd:143`), a fall (`rudy.gd:168`), a respawn (`rudy.gd:182`) and the circle (`rudy.gd:195`).
- **Signals:** none. Rudy's signals are `respawned`, `hit`, `hearts_changed`, `defeated` (`rudy.gd:35-38`); none marks the hitbox going live, and the brief adds none (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:41`). The trigger is the true → false edge of `Shape.disabled`, read each physics tick.
- **Place and facing:** the hitbox's global position, `slash_reach` 50 px × `facing`, 76 px above the soles (`rudy.gd:69`, `rudy.gd:240`, `rudy.tscn:41`); `facing` is `rudy.gd:78`.

### Effect B — running dust trail (`RunDust`)

- **Node type:** one `GPUParticles2D` root with a `ParticleProcessMaterial`, `local_coords` off, no `trail_enabled` (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:158`, `CHANGE-BRIEF.md:171`, `CHANGE-BRIEF.md:190`). Scene to create: `game/effects/run_dust.tscn` (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:158`).
- **Condition owner:** `game/content/rudy/rudy.gd`: `mode == Mode.PLAY` (`rudy.gd:80`, `rudy.gd:202`), `is_on_floor()` and `absf(velocity.x) > 1.0` (`rudy.gd:306`), the run test in `_pick_pose()` without its swing override (`rudy.gd:295-296`). Velocity is set at `rudy.gd:212-215`; a turn zeroes it (`rudy.gd:204-208`).
- **Signals:** none; the condition is read each physics tick (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:134`).

### Scenes the effects appear in

- `game/app/main.tscn`: `Main` with `Level1`, `Rudy`, `Camera`, `Hud`, `SystemKeys` (`main.tscn:9-27`). The effects driver and containers go under `Main`, not under Rudy or a goblin (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:125`, `CHANGE-BRIEF.md:222`). The camera follows Rudy's x (`game/app/main.gd:88`).
- `game/content/level_1/level_1.tscn`: the background they play over; walk line y = 840 (`level_1.tscn:40-44`), goblins (`level_1.tscn:69-77`), sword pickup x = 2500 (`level_1.tscn:79-80`).
- Pause: `Main.toggle_pause()` sets `get_tree().paused` (`main.gd:152-161`); only `SystemKeys` runs while paused (`game/app/system_keys.gd:15`). Reload: `main.gd:207-209`.
- Previews to create: `game/previews/slash_sparks_preview.tscn` and `game/previews/run_dust_preview.tscn` (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:257`, `CHANGE-BRIEF.md:268`).

### Tests (always through `scripts/run-test.sh`)

Usage: `scripts/run-test.sh <test-file in game/tests/> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` (`scripts/run-test.sh:2`, `:21-24`).

```bash
scripts/run-test.sh checks.tscn 60                    # 141 PASS, 0 FAIL (logs/checks_60fps.log)
scripts/run-test.sh invulnerable_tint_checks.tscn 30  # 15 PASS each at 30, 60, 144 (logs/invulnerable_tint_checks_*fps.log)
scripts/run-test.sh invulnerable_tint_checks.tscn 60
scripts/run-test.sh invulnerable_tint_checks.tscn 144
scripts/run-test.sh <test> realtime                   # no --fixed-fps; log is logs/<test>_realtime.log
scripts/run-test.sh <test> 60 300                     # third argument: timeout in s, default 120; 124 = hung
```

- It runs `godot --headless --path game`; `$GODOT`, else `godot` on PATH, else `/Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot` (`run-test.sh:25`, `:38`).
- A `.tscn` runs as the scene; a `.gd` runs with `--script`, so a `.gd` test must be a script `--script` can run, not one that extends `Node` (`run-test.sh:8-10`, `:31-35`).
- The log is `logs/<test>_<fps>fps.log` or `logs/<test>_realtime.log`; any `SHADER ERROR` or `SCRIPT ERROR` line fails the run even with exit 0 (`run-test.sh:37-41`). The existing logs end with `ERROR: N resources still in use at exit`, which does not fail it (`logs/checks_60fps.log`, last lines).
- `game/tests/capture.tscn` and `capture_tint.tscn` are windowed captures, not headless checks (`game/tests/capture.gd:1-4`, `game/tests/capture_tint.gd:1-7`).
- After every session: `git diff --stat game/shaders/` must print nothing (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:247`).

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

- Every file in `game/shaders/` is written by hand by the human and is never edited by an agent. That includes `invulnerable_tint.gdshader` and the future `particles_generated.gdshader`, which the human generates in the editor in Step 6 (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:219`). Do not create, edit, move or delete anything there.
- Effect settings live in the scene files in `game/effects/`, not in code. Driver code only places, mirrors, starts and stops the effects (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:224`); it never sets a particle or material property.

## Godot 4 names

- Use Godot 4 class and property names for 4.7.2, never Godot 3 names. Not `Particles2D` but `GPUParticles2D`; not `ParticlesMaterial` but `ParticleProcessMaterial`; not `initial_velocity` / `scale` / `damping` / `hue_variation` but their `_min` / `_max` pairs; not `flag_disable_z` / `flag_align_y` but `particle_flag_disable_z` / `particle_flag_align_y`.
- Confirmed in 4.7.2 by the probe that set and ran them (`evidence/compat-probe/probe.gd:23-61`, read back at `compatibility.log:7`): `GPUParticles2D` `amount`, `lifetime`, `texture`, `process_material`, `trail_enabled`; `ParticleProcessMaterial` `particle_flag_disable_z`, `gravity` and `direction` (Vector3), `spread`, `initial_velocity_min/_max`, `emission_shape` (`EMISSION_SHAPE_BOX` = 3), `emission_box_extents` (Vector3), `damping_min/_max`; `GradientTexture2D` `width`, `height`, `fill` (`FILL_RADIAL`), `fill_from`, `fill_to`, `gradient`.
- Every other name the brief uses is not yet exercised in this folder (see Unconfirmed). If you are unsure a property exists in 4.7.2, say so and check it (class reference or a load-and-read-back) instead of guessing. A wrong name in a `.tscn` loads silently at its default, which is predicted failure 1 (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:283`).

## Out of scope

- No gameplay change: Rudy, goblins, the level, Main's states, the HUD, the audio and the outline material stay as they are (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:210-216`). Presentation code may read game state but never writes it (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:225`), and no signal is added to `rudy.gd`.
- No change to collision, movement, input, the state machine or any timing (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:218`).
- `game/project.godot` stays as it is: the renderer stays GL Compatibility, no input action is added (F9 is read by a new debug node), no setting changes (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:217`, `:226`).
- No Compatibility-missing feature: no `trail_enabled` trail, no SDF collision, no `emit_particle()` (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:64`, `:313`). No new child in `rudy.tscn` (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:194`).
- Existing tests and their expected counts stay the same; new tests go beside them (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:220`). `main.tscn` gains only presentation nodes (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:222`).
